user.title: MMH Monitor
user.description: How do you want to connect this Home Assistant to the MMH central monitoring?

code.title: Enrollment code
code.description: Generate a code for this site in the MMH gateway panel (MMH Monitor section) and paste it here. The InfluxDB settings and token are filled in automatically.

data_description.site_slug: Lowercase identifier of the customer site, without spaces (e.g. cliente-exemplo).
data_description.enrollment_code: One-time code from the gateway panel, e.g. MMH-ABCDE-FGH23. Valid for 24 hours.
data_description.kuma_push_url: Optional. URL of the Push monitor for this site in Uptime Kuma.
data_description.gateway_url: Address of the MMH gateway. Keep the default unless told otherwise.

manual.title: MMH Monitor
manual.description: Connect this Home Assistant to the MMH central monitoring. A test point is written to InfluxDB before saving.

data_description.site_slug: Lowercase identifier of the customer site, without spaces (e.g. cliente-exemplo).
data_description.influx_url: Address of the central InfluxDB, including https://.
data_description.influx_bucket: Bucket that receives the health data.
data_description.influx_token: Write-only token created for this site.
data_description.kuma_push_url: Optional. URL of the Push monitor for this site in Uptime Kuma.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure MMH Monitor
reconfigure.description: How do you want to update the connection of site {site}?

reconfigure_code.title: Reconnect with a new code
reconfigure_code.description: Generate a new code for site {site} in the gateway panel. The gateway creates a new token and revokes the old one.

data_description.enrollment_code: One-time code from the gateway panel, e.g. MMH-ABCDE-FGH23. Valid for 24 hours.
data_description.gateway_url: Address of the MMH gateway. Keep the default unless told otherwise.

reconfigure_manual.title: Reconfigure MMH Monitor
reconfigure_manual.description: Update the central connection settings for site {site}.

data_description.influx_url: Address of the central InfluxDB, including https://.
data_description.influx_bucket: Bucket that receives the health data.
data_description.influx_token: Leave empty to keep the current token.
data_description.kuma_push_url: Optional. URL of the Push monitor for this site in Uptime Kuma.

error.invalid_slug: Use only lowercase letters, numbers, hyphen and underscore.

error.bucket_not_found: InfluxDB did not find this organization or bucket.

error.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts with invalid codes. Wait 15 minutes.
error.cannot_connect_gateway: Could not reach the MMH gateway.
error.gateway_error: The gateway could not complete the enrollment: {detail}

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration is possible.

data_description.kuma_down_on_critical: When the overall level is critical, send status down instead of up.
